Anti-bribery and corruption policy

Version[1.0]

1. Purpose

Prevent bribery, kickbacks and improper payments in all dealings.

2. Scope

All staff and anyone acting for the company.

3. Legal basis

UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 31 of 2021 (Penal Code) on bribery offences.

4. Policy

4.1  No one may offer, give, request or accept any bribe, facilitation payment or improper advantage, directly or through others.

4.2  Gifts and hospitality above AED [500] in value must be approved in advance by the Operations Manager and recorded in the gifts register.

4.3  Referral fees and agent splits are paid only under a written agreement and through the company's bank account.

4.4  Cash payments to or from staff in connection with a transaction are prohibited.

5. Responsibilities

5.1  All staff must read, acknowledge and follow this policy.

5.2  The Operations Manager maintains this policy, trains staff and monitors compliance.

5.3  Managers must report breaches immediately to the Owner.

6. Breaches

Breach of this policy may lead to disciplinary action up to termination of employment, and may be reported to the authorities where the law requires.

7. Review

This policy is reviewed at least once a year and whenever the law or the business changes.

Federal Decree-Law No. 20 of 2018 on AML/CFT and its implementing regulations, as amended; Ministry of Economy guidance for real estate brokers.

4. Policy

4.1  Identify and verify every buyer and seller (individuals and companies, including UBOs) before the transaction proceeds.

4.2  Apply enhanced due diligence to politically exposed persons, high-risk countries, cash or virtual-asset payments and complex ownership structures.

4.3  Screen all parties against UAE and UN sanctions lists before contracting and on any change.

4.4  Report cash transactions of AED 55,000 or more, and suspicious transactions, through goAML without tipping off the client.

4.5  Keep KYC and transaction records for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.

4.6  Train all relevant staff at least once a year.
